lead_headline: Ten days frozen: Restaurant detection extends June blackout through Friday—pipeline locked at 196 leads for 240 consecutive hours as liquor licensing enters day 35

restaurant.blurb: Tenth consecutive day without new leads—Friday marks 240 hours since last detection as June freeze solidifies into second full week. Active pipeline remains locked at 196 leads (108 openings, 88 closures).

foreclosure.blurb: Airport Road industrial property in Aurora posted $4.9M foreclosure filing—Arapahoe County listing scheduled for June 5 auction marks first $4M+ filing since May 23.

liquor.blurb: Day 35: June freeze reaches second Friday—Colorado's licensing shutdown extends 35th consecutive day with zero applications filed, zero status changes, zero administrative movement across 12,396 tracked licenses. The May paralysis now controls June's opening five business days as state authorities maintain complete silence on restoration timeline. The invisible backlog compounds while the apparatus posts its longest documented freeze in modern Colorado history. Friday closes first full week of June with zero regulatory signals as licensing machinery remains entirely dormant heading into second weekend.

reputation.blurb: Fifth consecutive day of elevated activity—BusinessDen logged 33 mentions across 7 sources in past 7 days, down 18% from prior week's 40 but holding above May baseline. Facebook and Denver Post each delivered 8 pickups, Instagram contributed 7. Notable coverage includes Denver Central Market vendor dispute (Reddit, Hoodline), Bubba Gump $1.8M sale (Hoodline), King Soopers opening, and 38th & Blake development progress. The week shows sustained citation velocity despite slight dip from Memorial Day peak. Google News RSS drives 100% of discovery as media attention maintains steady Friday drumbeat through early June.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled)—tenth consecutive flat day extends June's subscriber freeze through Friday as acquisition remains completely paralyzed. MTD net stuck at +0 (+0.0/day), 90-day net holds at +135. The past two weeks reveal sharp reversal: May 26-28 produced net +11 in 72 hours, then May 29-June 4 delivered ten straight zeros, fully erasing late-May burst. YTD pace of +1.2/day continues massively outperforming June's frozen MTD. The month-opening paralysis now spans ten consecutive trading days with zero acquisition activity as daily flow remains trapped in historic flatline following brief late-May recovery that collapsed immediately into June's blackout.
